periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt toward the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; width-to-height ratio approximately 1.5:1 along the primary axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the inferior vertex noticeably distant from the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curvature along the posterior dorsal boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band height is roughly 35-40% of the visible lateral torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap between ears is approximately equal to 1.2x the horizontal width of the pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness; the apex of each pinna is distinctly semicircular and rounded.
